first.rationale: I intend to test onboarding simplification because completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence indicates that reducing onboarding friction improves time-to-value and early activation. I will verify the onboarding result and the promotional-pricing downside before committing, since responding to competitor pricing may increase acquisition while harming retention and sustainable qualified revenue. A small guarded test limits downstream risk while preserving uncertainty about segment effects.

final.rationale: Run a guarded onboarding-simplification experiment for simple-workspace accounts only, excluding complex-workspace accounts where the archived record showed 60-day churn rising 9%. Monitor completion, activation, time-to-value, and retention against a control. This directly addresses the 4% onboarding-completion and 6% activation declines while using the prior activation evidence; avoid promotional pricing because its 12% retention loss undermines sustainable revenue.
